task_summary: I am a software developer. I need to modify the seat booking functionality to introduce new booking rules. Before making changes to the code, I need to understand the high-level architecture supporting this functionality. I want to identify the main components involved in the booking process, their responsibilities, and the interactions and dependencies among them. In particular, I need to understand which components are responsible for handling booking requests, checking seat availability, applying booking rules, managing and storing reservations, and interacting with external services such as the notification service. This understanding will help me identify which parts of the system need to be modified and which other components may be affected by the changes. | understand the high-level architecture supporting this functionality | seat booking functionality | The diagram must make clear the main components involved in the booking process, their responsibilities, interactions, and dependencies.

selected_view.purpose: Component-and-Connector Runtime View for modify: runtime components and connectors. Relations: connectors and communication. Do not: source packages drawn as runtime nodes.
selected_view.diagram_language_rule: viewpoint agent chose plantuml: PlantUML can accurately represent runtime components, connectors, and communication channels necessary for illustrating runtime connectivity and interaction sequences.

required_information.need: runtime components and connectors for seat booking functionality
component that handles seat booking functionality
persistence or external connector used by seat booking functionality

architectural_questions.text: Which connectors and communication channels link the main components involved in the seat booking functionality?
What is the sequence of calls between components when a request for the seat booking functionality runs?
Which modules and types own the responsibilities for checking seat availability and applying booking rules within the seat booking functionality?
